summary: A member’s marked-up procedural manual shows which questions they have worked through.
realLife: Riddick recalled that Senator Robert Byrd heavily annotated the copy of Senate Procedure he gave him, using red marks.
inGame: needs: a member’s working copy of the procedure manual.

turns.pulledBy: A colleague asks about one mark.

turns.what: The member dates a fresh note beside the old mark.
turns.pulledBy: A later ruling changes the answer.
